Respondent: State Of Kerala Represented By Its Chief Secretary, Government Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram - 695001. By Adv. Sri. V. Manu, Special Government Pleader To Ag, By Adv. Sri. V. Tekchand, Senior Govt. Pleader, By Adv. Sri. K. B. Pradeep, Amicus Curiae. texts.facts: By order dated 30 May 2025, the applicant was, therefore, directed to file a memo specifying the name of the newspaper and the edition. After issuing this direction to the applicant, the learned Single Judge also issued a general direction to the Registry to ensure that in all future applications for substituted service by newspaper publication, the name of the newspaper and the edition in which the publication is sought, must be stated before such applications are numbered.
texts.arguments: In I.A. No. 1 of 2025 in M.F.A. (E.C.C.) No. 9 of 2012, a learned Single Judge of this Court observed that though an application for substituted service by newspaper publication had been filed, the name of the newspaper and the edition in which publication was sought had not been mentioned.
